item.description: Aislado y con pocas opciones, Hughie recurre a medidas desesperadas. En Vought, Bradley y Stillwell se enfrentan a sus propias decisiones mientras los últimos secretos acercan la historia a su desenlace.

en.description: Isolated and running out of options, Hughie resorts to desperate measures. Within Vought, Bradley and Stillwell face decisions of their own as the remaining secrets bring the story towards its conclusion.
